title: The Royal palace in the capital
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：royal　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 royal 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the postman wrote of ① a royal palace in the capital in the list, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② so royal that nobody in the office would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the postman, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the royal ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the royal palace in the capital that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list for June 1965 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too royal to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the sender who had come to help; the royal ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a royal welcome for the guests, and said that no sender in his right mind would call it ⑥ as royal as the welcome for the guests they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was royal or not, and he said so.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something royal, and nothing besides. The sender from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite royal; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the royal ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981, year after year, she wrote of another royal palace in the capital in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less royal than anybody had expected. ⑩ The royal welcome for the guests that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1983, was the one she could never quite name; the royal ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 王室（前置定语 a royal palace in the capital：1971 年邮差在收发清单里记下的那件王室的王宫）
B. adj. 王室／盛大（两处加强说法：so royal that … 与 no less royal than …）
C. adj. 王室／盛大（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 王室（表语 too royal to do：母亲觉得它太王室，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 盛大（前置定语 a royal welcome for the guests：叔叔把整件事称作一桩盛大的欢迎）
F. adj. 盛大（同级比较 as royal as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩对客人的盛大欢迎相比）
G. adj. 盛大（后置定语 something royal：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 盛大（受程度副词修饰 quite royal：那位寄信人的评价）

items.q: a royal palace in the capital
the royal palace in the capital that
a royal welcome for the guests
The royal welcome for the guests that

answers.why: royal 意为“王室”，1971 年邮差在收发清单里记下的是“一件王室的王宫”，此处作前置定语 a royal palace in the capital。
royal 意为“王室”，此处用 so royal that 结构，说它王室到邮局里没人敢靠近。
royal 意为“王室”，收发清单上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的王室首都的王宫，等于最高级的说法。
royal 意为“王室”，母亲认为这件东西“太王室了，谁也用不上”，too royal to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
royal 意为“盛大”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩盛大的欢迎”，此处作前置定语 a royal welcome for the guests。
royal 意为“盛大”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩对客人的盛大欢迎一样盛大”，同级比较用 as royal as。
royal 意为“盛大”，收发清单上那半行字要的是“盛大的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something royal。
royal 意为“盛大”，邻邮局来的那位寄信人认为这套计划“相当盛大”，quite 修饰原级 royal。
royal 意为“盛大”，no less royal than 表示“其盛大不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之盛大不亚于任何人的预料。
royal 意为“盛大”，母亲 1983 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的盛大欢迎”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，邮差在收发清单里记下了一件王室的王宫。（a royal palace in the capital）
它王室到邮局里没有一个人敢靠近。（so royal that …）
母亲觉得它太王室，谁也用不上。（too royal to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩盛大的欢迎。（a royal welcome for the guests）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩对客人的盛大欢迎一样盛大。（as royal as …）
到了 1978 年，收发清单上只剩半行字：要的是一件盛大的东西。（something royal）
answers: In 1971 the postman wrote of a royal palace in the capital in the list.
It was so royal that nobody in the office would go near it.
My mother thought it too royal to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a royal welcome for the guests.
He said nobody would call it as royal as the welcome for the guests they had once had.
By 1978 the list asked for nothing but something royal.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 royal 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the postman wrote of a royal palace in the capital in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the royal palace in the capital that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too royal to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a royal welcome for the guests, and nobody argued with him.
The sender from the next office called the plan quite royal, and everybody laughed.
The royal ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
